dct_title_s: Sumatra Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Nov 2025
dct_description_sm: # Sumatra Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Nov 2025 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Sumatra Floods (Nov 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Aceh, Indonesia, Floods, 02 Dec 2025, v0.5** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: North Sumatra, Floods, 28 Nov 2025, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: North Sumatra, Indonesia, Floods, 28 Nov 2025, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Original data ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 Product - JAXA (2022-2025)
